_schema.description: Per-task target object body names for MetaWorld v3 datasets. Derived from each sawyer_*_v3.py env's _get_pos_objects() plus body names that appear in datasets_500/<task>/camera_data/<traj>/traj_task.json. A task can map to multiple body names when the operable object consists of nested bodies (e.g. basketball has bsktball + basketball).

fields.target_bodies: list of body:<name> (without the 'body:' prefix) that should be marked as target object in the binary mask. Empty-name child bodies cannot be referenced here -- use child_of instead.
fields.child_of: optional list of parent body names whose IMMEDIATELY NEXT actor in traj_task.json should also be included. Needed for parents that hold only a freejoint and whose geom-bearing child is anonymous (no <body name=...> in MJCF).
fields.confidence: high/medium/low - whether the env code unambiguously identifies these bodies

confidence_legend.high: body name explicitly appears in env's _get_pos_objects / obj_init_pos / _target_pos
confidence_legend.medium: inferred from handle/site naming + parent-body in MJCF; needs visual check
confidence_legend.low: best-guess, must verify before trusting mask

assembly-v3.notes: RoundNut parent has freejoint only; geom is on the next anonymous child (named asmbly_peg in seg)

basketball-v3.notes: bsktball is the movable body; basketball is a nested visual child

bin-picking-v3.notes: objA is the picked cube (child of obj)

box-close-v3.notes: top_link is the lid being moved; box stays fixed

coffee-button-v3.notes: site buttonStart is on cmbutton; coffee_machine is static

coffee-pull-v3.notes: obj is the movable mug container; mug is nested child

coffee-push-v3.notes: same mug as coffee-pull, pushed toward machine

dial-turn-v3.notes: dial parent has only joint+geoms via include; geom-bearing child is anonymous

door-close-v3.notes: door_link is the swinging door; door is the frame

door-lock-v3.notes: env sets obj_init_pos from lock_link; door/door_link stay put

drawer-close-v3.notes: drawer is the case, drawer_link is the sliding drawer

faucet-close-v3.notes: faucetBase is static housing; faucet_link(2) is the rotating handle

hammer-v3.notes: hammer is picked; nail_link is the nail it strikes (could also count as secondary target)

handle-press-side-v3.notes: handleStart site is on this handle; box is static housing

peg-insert-side-v3.notes: peg site pegGrasp; box is the hole target

peg-unplug-side-v3.notes: env uses plug1.xquat; plug is parent; plug_wall is the socket (static)

plate-slide-back-side-v3.notes: puck_goal parent has freejoint; geom on anonymous child

reach-v3.notes: obj is the red target cube being reached

stick-pull-v3.notes: stick parent freejoint only; geom on anonymous child. Robot grasps stick; bucket (object) is moved indirectly.

sweep-v3.notes: obj parent freejoint only; block geom on anonymous child

window-close-v3.notes: handleCloseStart site; windowb_a/_b are the two sliding panes; window is frame
